summary: This bill abolishes the Federal Reserve Board and all regional Federal Reserve banks one year after enactment, repeals the Federal Reserve Act, and requires the Treasury Secretary and OMB Director to liquidate their assets, pay off liabilities, and deposit net proceeds in the general Treasury fund.

scores.thoughts: The bill explicitly abolishes the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and all Federal Reserve banks, repeals the Federal Reserve Act, and mandates liquidation of their assets with net proceeds transferred to the Treasury's General Fund. This directly eliminates an entire federal agency and its associated operational expenditures, staff compensation, and ongoing liabilities (after liquidation). The effect is a clear and substantial reduction in government spending.
The bill contains no provisions related to tax rates, tax policy, revenue collection, or changes to the tax code.
The bill contains no provisions related to healthcare policy, insurance, public health programs, or medical regulation.
The bill contains no provisions related to firearms, gun regulations, or Second Amendment issues.
The bill contains no provisions related to immigration, border security, visas, or citizenship.
The bill contains no provisions related to reproductive rights, abortion access, or related regulations.
The bill contains no provisions related to military or defense spending.
The bill contains no provisions related to environmental regulations, climate policy, or natural resource management.
The bill contains no provisions related to welfare programs, food assistance, unemployment benefits, or other social safety net programs.
The bill contains no provisions related to schools, education funding, or school choice.
The bill contains no provisions related to drug enforcement, decriminalization, or substance regulation.
The bill contains no provisions related to policing, sentencing, incarceration, or criminal justice reform.
The bill contains no provisions related to tariffs, trade agreements, or international commerce regulation.

The bill requires net liquidation proceeds to be deposited in the General Fund of the Treasury. While this could indirectly support debt reduction, the legislation's primary purpose is abolishing the Federal Reserve rather than addressing fiscal deficits or debt levels, making any connection tangential at best.
The bill contains no provisions related to LGBTQ+ legal protections or rights.
The bill contains no provisions related to foreign aid, international assistance, or State Department funding.
The bill contains no provisions related to voting access, election administration, or campaign finance.
The bill contains no provisions related to technology regulation, data privacy, or surveillance.
The bill contains no provisions related to labor unions, worker protections, or employment law.
The bill contains no provisions related to religious exemptions, civil rights, or anti-discrimination law.
